title: I Hatched an Army to Stop the Moon.
summary: With four days until the moon hits, a kid hatches a Blue Fire Knight and a Storm Giant from the egg everyone mocked. The sword scratches the moon, and the town must choose how to reach it.
frame_0: The orange-scarved kid faces a burning, cratered moon from a clay rooftop, flanked by the Blue Fire Knight and the Storm Giant. The title and a 4 DAYS countdown sit above him.
camera: Steady opening cuts followed by one continuous glide from the cracking egg through the vote.
creature_handoff: Model Builder replacement proof 0cdcc1fa. Both new native character collections appear in the full film, rooftop, vote, posting thumbnail and sponsor preview.
audio: Locked voices. Original effects and CC0 location recordings. Effects fall silent in the square and when the moon stops.
thumbnail_source: Rooftop opening photographed with the actual cast and Model Builder assets.
photography: Native Cycles photography with motion-compensated in-between frames at 30 fps. The two editions use the same story photography and locked narration.
